feedback: Knee bend is a bit shallow.
Release happens with a strong arm extension.
Good follow-through: shooting hand holds near max height after release.
Good upward leg drive into the release.

coaching_items.title: Increase jump lift
coaching_items.why_it_matters: A little more lift can improve rhythm and make the shot easier to repeat from distance.
coaching_items.drill: Shoot short rhythm jumpers and focus on leaving the floor smoothly without drifting.

coaching_items.title: Get slightly deeper in the load
coaching_items.target: 130 degrees or lower at the deepest load
coaching_items.why_it_matters: A slightly deeper knee load can create power earlier, so the release does not have to do all the work.
coaching_items.drill: Use rhythm reps from close range: dip smoothly, keep balance, and rise without pausing.

coaching_items.title: Tighten arm motion consistency
coaching_items.why_it_matters: Less variation in the shooting arm helps the release happen the same way each time.
coaching_items.drill: Shoot slow form reps and check that the ball path and elbow finish match on every shot.
